capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: no page gives usable for the North American pack. Hyundai US calls 64.8 kWh the "battery system capacity" and Hyundai Canada says 64.8 kWh (src-hyundai-ca-kona-electric-2026); treated as gross. The same-generation European pack (different voltage, so only its ratio is used) has usable/nominal 65.4/68.5 = 0.955 (EVDB); 64.8 x 0.955 = 61.9. The repo also holds 58 (OpenEV, low confidence) for the 2026 Canadian car, 6 % lower: unreconciled.

chemistry.notes: NCM (NMC) cathode for the 2024 North American Kona Electric (64.8 kWh).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: 358 V nominal (96S) and 400 V charging architecture: 400 V class.

preconditioning.notes: Hyundai 2025 US SX2EV manual page: automatic when a DC charging station is set as destination or waypoint, plus manual "Activate" from the infotainment menu. Page does not name the model (SX2EV = Kona Electric), so low confidence. Hyundai UK page also states navigation preconditioning for the Kona Electric.

dc_max_kw.notes: Hyundai UK: 102 kW DC rapid charging for the 65.4 kWh pack (10-80 % in 41 min). North American pages give only 43 min at 100 kW and no peak; evspecs NA lists 100 kW. Same pack and generation.

ac_max_kw.notes: North American 2024 Kona Electric: 10.8 kW onboard charger (evspecs; autoevolution says 11 kW for the US car, Hyundai UK 10.5 kW for Europe). Canada Level 2 time 6 h 5 min equals the US figure, so same charger assumed.
